subject: Make opencode.json portable (relative mcp-graph.js path when in-workspace)
description: writeOpencodeMcp currently emits an absolute /Users/.../mcp-graph.js command path even when the install dir IS the workspace, making opencode.json machine-specific and uncommittable. Mirror writeMcp (claude/.mcp.json): when INSTALL_DIR resolves to the target workspace, emit a relative "mcp-graph.js" so opencode.json is portable like .mcp.json. Files: packages/cli/bin/zonoid.js (opencodeMcpEntry + writeOpencodeMcp call site), test/cli-init.test.js (assert relative path when in-workspace), and the local opencode.json (repin to relative). Exercising the opencode dispatcher→worker loop end-to-end.

summary: Made opencode.json portable: opencodeMcpEntry(cwd) now emits a relative "mcp-graph.js" command arg when cwd equals INSTALL_DIR (committable in-repo opencode.json), and the absolute path otherwise (global installs across workspaces). Updated the writeOpencodeMcp call site to pass cwd. Commit c068ff7d on orch/attempt/opencode-opencode-json-portable; full test/cli-init.test.js suite passes (exit 0), including 2 new portable-path assertions.
